subject: general
question: What is the name of the biography of actor and politician Shatrughan Sinha?

options.text: And Then One Day: A Memoir

solution:
The correct answer is __**Anything but Khamosh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shatrughan Prasad Sinha** is an** Indian politician and actor**. He served in the **Lok Sabha (2009–2014, 2014–2019) from Patna Sahib** and the** Rajya Sabha (1996–2002, 2002–2008).**
 
• In the** Atal Bihari Vajpayee government**, he was a **Union Cabinet Minister for Health and Family Welfare and Shipping.**
 
• He was a member of the **standing committee on transport, tourism, and culture** and a member of the consultative committee in** the ministry of external affairs and overseas Indian affairs** from** 2014 to 2019.**
 
• In **2016**, his biography, **Anything but Khamosh**, was released by **BJP veteran LK Advani.​**
 
• Sinha was selected by** Rediff **as one of the most **unconventional actors in Hindi cinema**. 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Substance and The Shadow**

 
 
• It's the** autobiography **of legendary actor** Yousuf Khan**, well-known professionally** as Dilip Kumar.**
 
• It was written by the** film journalist Udaya Tara Nayar.**
 
• Kumar appeared in approximately** 65 films** during the course of his five-decade career, playing a range of roles. He made his** acting debut **in the** Bombay Talkies film Jwar Bhata (1944).**
 
• The **Indian government** honoured him with the **Padma Bhushan in 1991 **and** the Padma Vibhushan in 2015,** the country's third and second highest civilian awards, respectively, for his services to film.
 
• In **1994**, he received the** Dadasaheb Phalke Award**, India's highest honour in the world of cinema.
 
• Kumar was awarded the** Nishan-e-Imtiaz**, **Pakistan's highest civilian decoration**, in **1998,** making him** the first and only Indian **to receive the honour.
 
• The **Pakistani government** declared the** house** where Kumar grew up, in **Peshawar**, a **national heritage monument in 2014.**
 
 
 
• **Khullam Khulla** 
 
 
• It's the** autobiography** of actor **Rishi Kapoor.**
 
• The** authors** of the book are **Rishi Kapoor and Meena Iyer**.
 
• Rishi Kapoor won a **National Award **for his** debut as an adult** and became an overnight sensation with his** first film** as a leading man **(Bobby, 1973).**
 
• As a** child**, he made his** cinematic debut** in his father** Raj Kapoor's Mera Naam Joker (1970)**, for which he won the **National Film Award **for **Best Child Artist.**
 
• He died of** leukaemia **on **30 April 2020, aged 67**.
 
 
 
• **And Then One Day: A Memoir**
 
 
• And Then one day: A Memoir is a candid depiction of** Naseeruddin Shah's** early years, struggles, and ascension into the film industry.
 
• Naseeruddin Shah is an **Indian film and theatre actor and director.**
 
• **Three National Film Awards**,** three Filmfare Awards**, and the **Volpi Cup for Best Actor at the Venice Film Festival** are among his many accolades.
 
• For his services to Indian cinema, the Indian government awarded him the** Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards.**
